name: layout_pages
description: One coordinated page of a layout, with its duration.
lifecycle: Replaced with the whole definition on every save; deleted with the layout.

columns.Meaning: Backend-generated page UUID, new on every save.
Company that owns the layout (tenant key).
How long the page shows, 1 to 600.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, layout_id) REFERENCES layouts(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The layout belongs to the same company; pages are deleted with it.
A layout has at most 20 pages.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX layout_pages_company_id_id_key ON public.layout_pages USING btree (company_id, id)
constraints.Purpose: Tenant key that page contents reference.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX layout_pages_position_key ON public.layout_pages USING btree (company_id, layout_id, "position")
constraints.Purpose: One page per position in a layout.
